### Installation method

Docker

### Package version

v0.16.0

### Description

When searching for a username ending in a period such as `alice.`, sherlock crashes on: `alice..empretienda.com.ar`

A possible solution could be similar to this https://github.com/sherlock-project/sherlock/issues/9 , but relate to FQDNs instead

### Steps to reproduce

1. Run sherlock with a username ending in a period, e.g. `alice.`
